obfuscation_indicators: other factors which could affect potential credit losses
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally precise and strongly quantified, with improving credit metrics, loan and deposit growth, and higher earnings supporting a moderately positive tone. Offsetting risks include declining net interest margin and yields, low-rate and competitive pricing pressure, and reliance on judgment in loan-loss provisioning. Boilerplate definitions and dense banking terminology increase complexity but do not materially obscure the main trends.
